_meta._status: REFERENCE — preserved from original product spec.
_meta._v1_implementation: Per ADR-029 and ADR-030, V1 reads this file as the platform-default + customer-tier-default seed for the gateways/tenant_config.py resolver. Customer-specific (L4) and customer-channel (L5) overrides land in the tenant_config table, not here.
_meta._partial_overrides: Per ADR-029, customer_behavior_overrides supply PARTIAL weight maps. The V1 resolver fills missing keys from the next-higher level in the hierarchy and asserts sum==1.0 within 1e-4 tolerance. No silent renormalization.
_notes: drop_ship.line_items=0.10 looks counter-intuitive vs. ERP-veteran reviewer expectation (drop-ship usually wants line-items emphasized, not de-emphasized). Flagged for product-owner review per ADR-029 Notes; admin can override per customer.
customer_behavior_overrides are applied to the customer-specific layer (L4) by admin tooling; they are not a sixth layer in the hierarchy.

blanket_po.description: Same PO number used across multiple releases — reduce PO number weight

drop_ship.description: Different ship-to per order is normal — reduce ship-to weight

high_frequency.description: Frequent reorders — tighten timestamp, increase line-item weight
